issues.description: The problem statement's UML shows the SealSaloon attribute 'totalOrders' as type int, but the solution implementation declares totalOrders as long. This type mismatch across the specification and solution can confuse students about the expected type for totalOrders and may lead to inconsistent implementations or failing type-sensitive tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of totalOrders consistent between the specification and implementation. Either change the UML/problem statement to indicate 'totalOrders: long' or change the solution (and any provided templates/tests) to declare totalOrders as an int and update the getter signature accordingly. Prefer adjusting the solution to use int if the exercise semantics expect int, or update the problem text/UML to long if larger counts are intended.
